suggested_routes.label: Insufficient content — meeting not yet started
suggested_routes.rationale: The only available evidence is the organiser saying they are finishing another call and will join in a couple of minutes. No substantive conversation, topic, or participant role is established. Human review is required once more of the meeting content is available.

concise_output: The only captured content is the organiser indicating they are finishing another call and will join shortly. No meeting substance, topic, or participants are established — this record cannot be meaningfully routed without further content.
what_established: The meeting organiser was on another call at the start of this session and indicated they would join in a couple of minutes.
what_not_established: Meeting topic, attendees, customer or prospect involved, deal value, any discussion content, or outcome.
next_action: Retrieve the remainder of the meeting transcript or recording; re-run analysis once substantive content is available.
uncertainty: The meeting has effectively not started in the captured evidence; no routing decision can be made on a brief pre-meeting placeholder statement.
